content: When a product is expired or no longer needed, it should be properly discarded. This information was last updated in May 2024. Important Usage Information: The details provided here are a summary and do not include all possible information about the product. This information does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific needs. It is not intended to replace individual medical advice or the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health requirements. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. It is important to maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication can be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Notes: To prevent the spread of lice, wash all recently used clothing, hats, bedding, and towels in hot water or have them dry-cleaned. Storage Instructions: Store this medication at room temperature and do not freeze it. This product is intended for single use only. Discard any unused lotion. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
